name: GPU Instancing with Layered Offset for Volume Clouds
definition: A rendering technique that uses GPU instancing to render multiple layers of a cloud mesh, where each layer is offset vertically to simulate volume thickness, and parameters like clip threshold and noise tiling are varied per instance to create depth variation.
summary: GPU Instancing with Layered Offset for Volume Clouds renders volumetric clouds by drawing multiple vertically offset mesh layers with distinct noise parameters, differing from ray-marching by using discrete geometry.
